news.headline: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
news.summary: June is tackling deployment friction in enterprise AI with $20M in pre-seed backing from Marc Benioff and others. The stealth-exit startup aims to simplify how companies actually implement AI systems into their workflows.

news.headline: Sam Altman and AI’s decel debate
news.summary: Sam Altman is pushing the AI industry to pump the brakes on development speed. On the latest Equity podcast, the conversation centers on his call for a measured approach to advancing artificial intelligence. The debate highlights growing tensions between innovation velocity and responsible deployment in tech's hottest sector.

educational.title: How Interest Rates Actually Move Your Money
points: The Fed sets a target rate that ripples into loans, mortgages, and savings
Higher rates make borrowing pricier — car loans and mortgages cost more
Higher rates also make saving pay better — bank yields tend to rise too
Stocks often wobble on rate news because future profits get discounted more
You don't need to predict rates — just understand why headlines move markets
